sources.evidence: Serenis, founded in 2021 by Silvia Wang and Daniele Francescon, announces a €12m Series A capital increase co-led by Angelini Ventures and CDP Venture Capital through Digital Transition Fund. Named additional participants: Azimut Libera Impresa, X-Equity Venture Club, Invictus Capital, Lumen Ventures, FG2 Capital, Club degli Investitori and Doorway. €20m is cumulative fundraising, not this round.

sources.title: Angelini Ventures invests in Serenis
sources.timestamp_basis: researcher observation clock after page read; provider network-fetch time not exposed
sources.evidence: Angelini co-led a €2.7m seed extension including FG2 Capital, Lumen Ventures, Azimut Digitech Fund, Invictus Capital and unnamed angels. The displayed date 11/10/2022 is retained without assuming day/month order; total fundraising €6.5m is distinct from the extension.
